card.name: Website instructions to the reader
card.fires_on: Words inside direct web-page instructions or requests to the visitor, such as "please read ... before", "entering your contact information", or "click here to continue". Also words in forum help requests.

modes.label: Page instructions
modes.description: Words in site notices telling the reader what to do or where to go.
modes.example: Please read the page creation guidelines<< before>> creating a new page.

modes.label: Forum help request
modes.description: Words in a poster's plea for a quick answer.
modes.example: Hi! I have an English exam very soon, so I<< need>> the answer of this fast.

modes.label: Subscriber or form prompts
modes.description: Words in prompts to enter details or click to continue.
modes.example: Subscribers please click here<< to>> continue reading.

card.plain: It lights up on everyday website wording that tells the visitor what to read, click or fill in.
